findings.highlight: destroys the wall of the castle
findings.evidenceJa: 城の壁を貫き、広間の壁を倒壊させていく
findings.governingReading: pierces the castle wall and brings down the wall of the great hall
findings.explanation: Two distinct structures and the projectile’s path collapse into one wall.

findings.evidenceJa: 家ほどもある瓦礫の塊
findings.governingReading: a mass of rubble as large as a house
findings.explanation: The lethal scale of the falling ruin is heavily weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: 脳を不能なまでにかき回している
findings.governingReading: churns my brain until it can no longer function
findings.explanation: The impending cognitive breakdown caused by contradictory impulses disappears.

findings.highlight: the other side of the wall
findings.governingReading: against the wall diametrically opposite me
findings.explanation: Shinji is relocated through or beyond a wall rather than across the hall.

findings.highlight: I was like that when Rider got killed
findings.evidenceJa: 僕もライダーの時はそうだった
findings.governingReading: I was the same way in Rider’s case
findings.explanation: Shinji’s vague comparison to his experience with Rider is promoted into her death.

findings.evidenceJa: このままじゃ確実に死ぬ
findings.governingReading: you will certainly die if this continues
findings.explanation: The conditional situation and certainty are weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: よくわからない事を、口にした
findings.governingReading: he says something I cannot make sense of
findings.explanation: Shirou’s failure to understand Shinji’s offer becomes a claim that it is inconceivable.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂をなめ回すような視線
findings.governingReading: his gaze crawls over Tohsaka as though licking her
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s objectifying scrutiny of Rin is entirely neutralized.

findings.highlight: because you know I would not stop
findings.governingReading: because you judged that I would not stop, girl
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s condescending form of address disappears.

findings.highlight: I’m warning you since I’ve known you for a long time
findings.governingReading: I warn you because of our long, ill-fated attachment
findings.explanation: Rin’s barbed acknowledgment of her history with Shinji is neutralized.

findings.governingReading: the sight of his Master raging
findings.explanation: The narration’s neutral description of Shinji’s anger becomes an added moral judgment.
